summary: Reproduced the DCP widened-logical versus rank-local-physical index mismatch in the current cpu_tensor retraction path and localized MLA token indices at MLATokenToKVPool CPU backup/restore. Restore independently translates newly allocated logical destinations; DCP=1 remains identity and Mamba/KDA indices are outside the changed boundary.

remaining_limitations: No Kimi-K3 weights were available, so the full model architecture and semantic accuracy were not validated.
The reported TP8/DCP8 PD-disaggregated NVIDIA B300 workload requires eight GPUs; this job had one AMD gfx950 GPU, so no full serving or multi-rank runtime reproduction is claimed.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the affected hybrid MLA plus KDA architecture and was therefore not substituted for the reported workload.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module; git diff --check and focused tests were used instead.
